pages.text: A wireless crystal links to other crystals like any crystal does, and also to machines without touching them.$(li)Basic: 4 crystal links, 16 machines, 32,000 OP/t per machine$(li)Wyvern: 8 crystal links, 32 machines, 128,000 OP/t$(li)Draconic: 16 crystal links, 64 machines, 512,000 OP/t
Higher tiers are crafted from the tier below; the Draconic one is in JEI.
Particles show energy moving between the crystal and each machine.

pages.title: Linking machines
pages.text: Save the wireless crystal to a $(item)Crystal Binder$(), then right-click a machine on the side the energy should go through. Click the same machine again to unlink it. A side that cannot take or give energy is refused.$(br2)$(l)Shift-right-click$() the crystal to switch between $(6)Output to Block$() (powers the machines, the default) and $(3)Input from Block$() (pulls from generators or energy stores).
